description: Stations de tram is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Cette donnée est issue du référentiel cartographique au 1/10000ème et est conçue pour des échelles moyennes (du 1/5 000e au 1/25 000e). Sa précision est de 5 à 10m. La donnée reflète l'état du réseau dans notre SIG en date du 8 avril 2022. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are station, tram, tramway, Strasbourg. The portal shows 102 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
